exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B proud      11  B because
   2  C in         12  B of
   3  B up         13  C much
   4  C more       14  B than
   5  B than       15  B well
   6  B most       16  B faster
   7  C but        17  B loud
   8  B dirty      18  C more
   9  A and        19  A the
  10  C into       20  C very


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  QIYOSIY DARAJA (Unit 12) —
     4, 5, 13, 14, 16, 18
  USTUN DARAJA (Unit 12) — 2, 6, 12, 19
  'AS ... AS' (Unit 12) — 8
  SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (Unit 11) — 1, 15, 17
  BOG'LOVChILAR (Unit 11) — 7, 9, 11
  HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI (Unit 11) — 3, 10
  'QUITE/VERY/TOO' (Unit 12) — 20


──── SIFAT ↔ RAVISh (Unit 11) ────

  ⚠ ASOSIY QOIDA:

     SIFAT — OTni tasvirlaydi yoki 'be'
        dan keyin keladi
     RAVISh — FE'Lni tasvirlaydi


   1  'He IS very PROUD of his new car.'
      'is' dan keyin → SIFAT.
      ⚠ 'proudly' — ravish, 'is' bilan
      kelmaydi.
      ⚠ 'be proud OF' — predlog 'of'.

  15  'Amy PLAYS basketball WELL.'
      'plays' (FE'L) ni tasvirlaydi →
      RAVISh.
      ⚠ 'good' — SIFAT ('a good player').
      ⚠ 'good' ning ravishi — 'WELL'
      (noto'g'ri shakl!).

  17  'she heard a LOUD NOISE.'
      'noise' (OT) dan OLDIN → SIFAT.
      ⚠ 'loudly' — ravish ('She spoke
      LOUDLY').

  ⚠ UCh BANDNI SOLIShTIRING:
     'He is PROUD.'        (be + sifat)
     'She plays WELL.'     (fe'l + ravish)
     'a LOUD noise'        (sifat + ot)


──── QIYOSIY DARAJA ────

  ⚠ QAYSI ShAKL — SIFATNING UZUNLIGIGA
  QARANG:

     1 BO'G'IN → '-ER ... THAN'
        heavy → heavIER (5-band)
        fast → fastER (16-band)
        clever → cleverER (13-band)

     2+ BO'G'IN → 'MORE ... THAN'
        beautiful → MORE beautiful
           (4-band)
        quickly → MORE quickly (18-band)

  ⚠ 'THAN' — DOIM kerak (5, 14-bandlar).


⚠ 13 va 16-BANDLAR — 'MUCH' + QIYOSIY:

  13  'She is MUCH CLEVERER than her
      sister.'
  16  'The cheetah is MUCH FASTER than the
      lion.'

  ⚠ Qiyosiy darajani KUChAYTIRISh:
     MUCH / A LOT / FAR + qiyosiy daraja
     'VERY cleverer' — XATO!

  ⚠ 20-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
  ODDIY sifat → 'VERY clean'.


⚠ 18-BAND — RAVIShNING QIYOSIY DARAJASI:

  'Susan can read MORE QUICKLY than Jane.'

  ⚠ '-ly' ga tugagan RAVIShLAR DOIM 'MORE'
  bilan:
     quickly → MORE quickly
     slowly → MORE slowly
     carefully → MORE carefully

  ISTISNO (qisqa ravishlar):
     fast → faster;  hard → harder;
     early → earlier


──── USTUN DARAJA ────

   2  'John is the SHORTEST student IN his
      class.'
      ⚠ USTUN daraja + GURUH → 'IN'.

   6  'Judy is THE MOST INTELLIGENT student
      in the class.'
      'intelligent' — UZUN sifat →
      'the MOST'.

  12  'tennis is the BEST sport OF all.'
      ⚠ 'the best OF all' — predlog 'of'.

  19  'This is THE most expensive dress of
      all.'
      ⚠ USTUN darajada DOIM 'THE'.

  ⚠ 2, 6, 12, 19 — PREDLOGLAR FARQI:
     'the shortest IN his class' (guruh)
     'the best OF all' (hammasidan)


──── 'AS ... AS' ────

   8  'Villages are NOT AS DIRTY AS large
      cities.'

  ⚠ 'as ... as' orasida ODDIY sifat
  turadi (qiyosiy daraja EMAS!):
     'as DIRTY as'    ✓
     'as DIRTIER as'  ✗
     'as DIRTIEST as' ✗

  'not as ... as' = ... chalik emas.


──── BOG'LOVChILAR ────

   7  'My mother wanted to go ... BUT my
      father didn't.'
      QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.

   9  'Chris turned off the light AND went
      to sleep.'
      KETMA-KET ish → AND.

  11  'He opened the window BECAUSE it was
      very hot.'
      SABAB → BECAUSE.
      ⚠ 'so' bo'lsa tartib teskari bo'lardi:
      'It was hot, SO he opened the
       window.'


──── HARAKAT PREDLOGLARI ────

   3  'Go UP the stairs and turn left.'
      ⚠ 'go UP the stairs' = zinadan
      YUQORIGA chiqmoq.
      'go DOWN the stairs' = pastga tushmoq.

  10  'The ball fell INTO the swimming-
      pool.'
      ⚠ 'INTO' — tashqaridan IChKARIGA
      harakat.
      'along' = bo'ylab; 'towards' = tomon.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  proud of    = ... dan faxrlanadi
  stairs      = zina
  a village   = qishloq
  dirty       = iflos
  to turn off = o'chirmoq
  a swimming-pool = suzish havzasi
  a cheetah   = gepard
  noise       = shovqin
  loud        = baland ovozli
  expensive   = qimmat
  intelligent = aqlli
  Vienna      = Vena (Avstriya poytaxti)

tasks.prompt: 1  He is very ................. of his new car.
tasks.whyUz:
'IS' dan keyin → SIFAT kerak → PROUD.

⚠ 'proudly' — RAVISH, 'is' bilan kelmaydi.
⚠ 'prouder' — qiyosiy daraja, 'than' kerak
bo'lardi.

'be proud OF something' — predlog 'of'.

tasks.prompt: 2  John is the shortest student ................. his class.
tasks.promptUz: Jon sinfidagi eng past bo'yli o'quvchi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ USTUN DARAJA + GURUH → 'IN':
  the shortest IN his class
  the best IN the world

⚠ 12-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
'the best OF all' (hammasidan).

tasks.prompt: 3  Go ................. the stairs and turn left.
tasks.promptUz: Zinadan yuqoriga chiqing va chapga buriling.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'go UP the stairs' = zinadan YUQORIGA
chiqmoq.
'go DOWN the stairs' = pastga tushmoq.

'through' = ichidan o'tib;
'into' = ichiga (10-band).

tasks.prompt: 4  Paris is ................. beautiful than Vienna.
tasks.whyUz:
'beautiful' — UZUN sifat (3 bo'g'in)
→ 'MORE ... THAN'.

⚠ 'most' — USTUN daraja ('the most
beautiful'), lekin gapda 'than' bor.
⚠ 'much' — qiyosiy darajani kuchaytiradi,
lekin o'zi qiyosiy yasamaydi.

tasks.prompt: 5  He is heavier ................. me.
tasks.whyUz:
QIYOSIY darajada DOIM 'THAN':
  heavier THAN / faster THAN / more
  beautiful THAN

'heavy' → heavIER (undosh + y → i + er).

tasks.prompt: 6  Judy is the ................. intelligent student in the class.
tasks.whyUz:
'intelligent' — UZUN sifat → USTUN daraja
'the MOST intelligent'.

KALIT: 'THE' allaqachon bosilgan → ustun
daraja.

⚠ 4-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda 'than'
bor → qiyosiy daraja 'MORE'.

tasks.prompt: 7  My mother wanted to go to the cinema ................. my father didn't.
tasks.promptUz: Onam kinoga bormoqchi edi, lekin dadam xohlamadi.
tasks.whyUz:
QARAMA-QARSHILIK (biri xohladi, biri
xohlamadi) → BUT.

'because' — sabab;
'so' — natija.

⚠ 9 va 11-bandlar bilan solishtiring.

tasks.prompt: 8  Villages are not as ................. as large cities.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'AS ... AS' orasida ODDIY sifat turadi:
  'as DIRTY as'    ✓
  'as DIRTIER as'  ✗
  'as DIRTIEST as' ✗

'not as ... as' = ... chalik emas.

tasks.prompt: 9  Chris turned off the light ................. went to sleep.
tasks.promptUz: Kris chiroqni o'chirdi va uxlagani ketdi.
tasks.whyUz:
KETMA-KET ikki ish → AND.

Chiroqni o'chirish va uxlash — bir-biriga zid
emas ('but' XATO) va biri ikkinchisining
sababi emas ('so' zaif).

tasks.prompt: 10  The girl's ball fell ................. the swimming-pool.
tasks.promptUz: Qizning to'pi suzish havzasiga tushib ketdi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'INTO' — tashqaridan ICHKARIGA harakat.

'along' = bo'ylab ('walk along the street');
'towards' = tomon ('walk towards the door').

Coursebook 114-bet: 'throw bottles INTO the
sea'.

tasks.prompt: 11  He opened the window ................. it was very hot.
tasks.promptUz: U derazani ochdi, chunki juda issiq edi.
tasks.whyUz:
SABAB → BECAUSE.

[natija] BECAUSE [sabab]:
issiq — SABAB, deraza ochish — NATIJA.

⚠ 'so' bo'lsa TARTIB TESKARI bo'lardi:
'It was hot, SO he opened the window.'

tasks.prompt: 12  I think tennis is the best sport ................. all.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'the best OF all' — predlog 'OF'.

⚠ 2-band bilan solishtiring:
  'the shortest IN his class' (GURUH)
  'the best OF all' (HAMMASIDAN)

'than' — qiyosiy daraja bilan.

tasks.prompt: 13  She is ................. cleverer than her sister.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ QIYOSIY DARAJANI KUCHAYTIRISH → MUCH:
  MUCH cleverer / A LOT cleverer /
  FAR cleverer

⚠ 'VERY cleverer' — XATO!
⚠ 'more cleverer' — ikki qiyosiy, XATO
('clever' qisqa → 'cleverER').

tasks.prompt: 14  Is the Missouri River longer ................. the Amazon?
tasks.whyUz:
QIYOSIY darajada DOIM 'THAN'.

⚠ 'as' — 'as long AS' qurilmasida ishlatiladi
(8-band), lekin u yerda 'longer' emas, 'long'
bo'lardi.

⚠ Daryolar oldida 'THE': the Missouri,
the Amazon.

tasks.prompt: 15  Amy plays basketball ................. .
tasks.whyUz:
'PLAYS' (FE'L) ni tasvirlaydi → RAVISH
→ WELL.

⚠ 'good' — SIFAT ('a GOOD player').
⚠ 'good' ning ravishi — 'WELL' (noto'g'ri
shakl!).
⚠ 'best' — ustun daraja, 'the' kerak
bo'lardi.

tasks.prompt: 16  The cheetah is much ................. than the lion.
tasks.whyUz:
'than' bor → QIYOSIY daraja → FASTER.

'fast' — 1 bo'g'in → '-ER'.

⚠ 'much' + qiyosiy daraja (13-band bilan bir
xil qoida).
⚠ 'fastest' — ustun daraja, 'than' bilan
kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 17  Karen woke up because she heard a ................. noise.
tasks.promptUz: Keren uyg'onib ketdi, chunki baland shovqin eshitdi.
tasks.whyUz:
'noise' (OT) dan OLDIN → SIFAT → LOUD.

⚠ 'loudly' — RAVISH ('She spoke LOUDLY').
⚠ 'loudest' — ustun daraja, 'the' kerak.

⚠ 15-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda FE'L
tasvirlanadi → ravish 'well'.

tasks.prompt: 18  Susan can read ................. quickly than Jane.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ '-LY' ga tugagan RAVISHLAR DOIM 'MORE'
bilan:
  quickly → MORE quickly
  slowly → MORE slowly

ISTISNO (qisqa ravishlar): fast → faster,
hard → harder, early → earlier.

'than' bor → qiyosiy daraja.

tasks.prompt: 19  This is ................. most expensive dress of all.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ USTUN DARAJADA DOIM 'THE':
  THE most expensive / THE best /
  THE shortest

'a most expensive' — XATO.
'than' — qiyosiy daraja bilan.

'OF all' — 12-band bilan bir xil.

tasks.prompt: 20  This city is ................. clean.
tasks.whyUz:
'clean' — ODDIY sifat (qiyosiy daraja emas)
→ VERY.

⚠ 'MUCH clean' — XATO! 'much' faqat QIYOSIY
daraja bilan ('much cleaner').

⚠ 'too clean' grammatik to'g'ri, lekin ma'nosi
SALBIY ('haddan tashqari toza') — bu yerda
mantiqsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  faster
   2  fell off
   3  saw
   4  What's ... in
   5  How are you
   6  like
   7  Why don't we
   8  on fire
   9  when
  10  Can you
  11  don't we
  12  more ... than
  13  bigger than
  14  much
  15  afraid
  16  ate
  17  hotter
  18  ago
  19  How old
  20  can visit

⚠ 4, 5, 7, 10, 19-bandlar GAP BOShIDA turadi
→ kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── QIYOSIY DARAJA (Unit 11) ────

  Bu testning ASOSIY mavzusi.

 1  'A plane travels FASTER than a train.'
    fast → FASTER (qisqa sifat + '-er')

12  'This restaurant is MORE expensive THAN
     that one.'
    ⚠ UZUN sifat → 'MORE ... THAN'
    ('expensiver' XATO!)

13  'My flat is big, but yours is much
     BIGGER THAN mine.'
    big → BIGGER ('g' IKKILANADI)

17  'It's hot today but it was HOTTER
     yesterday.'
    hot → HOTTER ('t' IKKILANADI)

  ⚠ QOIDA — QAySI ShAKL:

     1 BO'G'INLI sifat → '-ER ... THAN'
        fast → faster
        big → bigger ('g' ikkilanadi)
        hot → hotter ('t' ikkilanadi)

     2+ BO'G'INLI sifat → 'MORE ... THAN'
        expensive → MORE expensive
        beautiful → MORE beautiful

     ISTISNO ('-y' ga tugaydiganlar):
        happy → happIER
        easy → easIER

     NOTO'G'RI:
        good → BETTER
        bad → WORSE


──── 'MUCH' + QIYOSIY DARAJA ────

14  'His car is MUCH cheaper than yours.'

  ⚠ Qiyosiy darajani KUChAYTIRISh:
     MUCH cheaper   ✓
     A LOT cheaper  ✓
     FAR cheaper    ✓
     VERY cheaper   ✗ !!!

  'very' faqat ODDIY sifat bilan:
     'very cheap'   ✓
     'very cheaper' ✗

  (2-mashqning 6-bandi ham shu qoida.)


──── TAKLIF QILISh (Unit 12) ────

 7  'WHY DON'T WE go to Paris for our
     holiday?'
11  'Why DON'T WE go to Cairo this summer?'

  ⚠ 7-bandda 'SHALL WE' yoki 'HOW ABOUT WE'
  ham to'g'ri; lekin 11-band bilan bir xil
  qurilma bo'lgani uchun 'Why don't we'
  eng ehtimolli.

  TAKLIF ShAKLLARI:
     'Why don't we GO ...?'
     'Shall we GO ...?'
     'How about GOING ...?'  (V-ing!)
     'Let's GO ...'


──── PAST SIMPLE ────

 2  'She FELL OFF the ladder and broke her
     leg.'
    ⚠ 'fall OFF' = tushib ketmoq
    (narsadan).
    fall → FELL → fallen

 3  'We SAW Independence Day at the cinema
     last Monday.'
    ⚠ 'WATCHED' ham to'g'ri.
    'see a film AT THE CINEMA' — odatiy
    birikma.
    see → SAW → seen

16  'There aren't any biscuits. John ATE
     them all.'
    eat → ATE → eaten

18  'We went to the USA three months AGO.'
    ⚠ 'AGO' — o'lchovdan KEYIN, GAP OXIRIDA.
    DOIM Past Simple bilan.


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

 4  'WHAT'S the tallest building IN your
     city?'
 5  'HOW ARE YOU, Mr Morrison? — Very well,
     thank you.'
10  'CAN YOU give me your phone number,
     please?'
    ('COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri)
19  'HOW OLD was he when he died? — 37.'


──── LUG'AT ────

 6  'My sister LOOKS LIKE me.'
    ⚠ 'look LIKE somebody' = kimgadir
    O'XShAMOQ.
    'look like' — TAShQI KO'RINISh.

 8  'The house is ON FIRE! Quick. Call the
     fire brigade.'
    ⚠ 'ON FIRE' = yonyapti (turg'un ibora).
    'in fire' — XATO.

 9  'She was in the kitchen WHEN the
     doorbell rang.'
    ⚠ Davom etayotgan holat + TO'SATDAN
    sodir bo'lgan ish → 'WHEN'.

15  'Don't be AFRAID. It won't hurt you.'
    ⚠ 'BE afraid' — 'have afraid' XATO!
    'SCARED' ham to'g'ri.

20  'There are a lot of places you CAN VISIT
     in Los Angeles.'
    'CAN SEE' ham to'g'ri.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a ladder    = narvon
  to fall off = tushib ketmoq
  Independence Day = Mustaqillik kuni
                  (film nomi)
  in fact     = aslida
  on fire     = yonayotgan
  the fire brigade = o't o'chirish bo'limi
  a doorbell  = eshik qo'ng'irog'i
  to ring     = jiringlamoq
  a flat      = kvartira
  afraid      = qo'rqqan
  to hurt     = og'ritmoq

tasks.whyUz:
'than' bor → QIYOSIY DARAJA.

'fast' — 1 BO'G'INLI → '-ER': FASTER.

⚠ 'more fast' XATO — qisqa sifatga '-er'.

tasks.prompt: 2  She ......................... the ladder and broke her leg.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'FALL OFF something' = narsadan tushib
ketmoq.

fall → FELL → fallen (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'fell from the ladder' ham eshitiladi, lekin
'fall OFF' tabiiyroq.
tasks.speak: 2  She ......................... the ladder and broke her leg.

tasks.prompt: 3  We ..................................... Independence Day at the cinema last Monday.
tasks.promptUz: Biz o'tgan dushanba kinoteatrda 'Mustaqillik kuni' filmini ko'rdik.
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: 'LAST MONDAY' → PAST SIMPLE.

see → SAW → seen.

⚠ 'WATCHED' ham to'g'ri.
'see a film AT THE CINEMA' — odatiy birikma
(kinoteatrda 'see', uyda 'watch').
tasks.speak: 3  We ..................................... Independence Day at the cinema last Monday.

tasks.prompt: 4  ............... the tallest building   (birinchi bo'sh joy)
tasks.whyUz:
'WHAT'S' = What IS.

'the tallest' — USTUN daraja (Unit 11).
tall → taller → THE TALLEST.
tasks.speak: 4  ............... the tallest building   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

tasks.prompt: 4  What's the tallest building ............... your city?
tasks.whyUz:
SHAHAR bilan 'IN'.

2-mashqning 5-bandi ham shu:
'the cleverest boy IN the class'.

⚠ Ustun daraja + guruh → 'IN'.
tasks.speak: 4  What's the tallest building ............... your city?

tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'VERY WELL, thank you' — AHVOL.

'How are you?' — turg'un savol.

1 va 2-nazorat testlarida ham uchragan.

tasks.prompt: 6  My sister looks ......................... me, but in fact, she's two years older than me.
tasks.promptUz: Opam menga o'xshaydi, lekin aslida u mendan ikki yosh katta.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'LOOK LIKE somebody' = kimgadir O'XSHAMOQ.

  'She looks LIKE me.' = menga o'xshaydi
  'She looks tired.' = charchagan ko'rinadi
     ('like' YO'Q — sifat bilan)

'in fact' = aslida.
tasks.speak: 6  My sister looks ......................... me, but in fact, she's two years older than me.

tasks.whyUz:
TAKLIF → 'WHY DON'T WE ...?'

⚠ 'SHALL WE ...?' va 'HOW ABOUT WE ...?' ham
to'g'ri.

11-band bilan BIR XIL qurilma, shuning uchun
'Why don't we' eng ehtimolli javob.

tasks.prompt: 8  Oh no! The house is .....................................!  Quick. Call the fire brigade.
tasks.promptUz: Voy! Uy yonyapti! Tez. O't o'chiruvchilarni chaqiring.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'ON FIRE' = yonyapti (TURG'UN IBORA).

  'The house is ON FIRE.'  ✓
  'The house is IN fire.'  ✗

KALIT: 'Call the FIRE BRIGADE' — o't o'chirish
bo'limi.
tasks.speak: 8  Oh no! The house is .....................................!  Quick. Call the fire brigade.

tasks.prompt: 9  She was in the kitchen ............. the doorbell rang.
tasks.promptUz: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringlaganda u oshxonada edi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ Davom etayotgan HOLAT ('she WAS in the
kitchen') + TO'SATDAN sodir bo'lgan ish
('the doorbell RANG') → 'WHEN'.

ring → RANG → rung (noto'g'ri fe'l).
tasks.speak: 9  She was in the kitchen ............. the doorbell rang.

tasks.prompt: 10  ..................... give me your phone number, please?
tasks.whyUz:
MULOYIM ILTIMOS → 'CAN YOU ...?'

⚠ 'COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri (muloyimroq).

5-nazorat testining 11-bandi bilan bir xil.
tasks.speak: 10  ..................... give me your phone number, please?

tasks.whyUz:
'Why' allaqachon bosilgan → 'DON'T WE'.

'Why DON'T WE go ...?' — TAKLIF.

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'don't we GO'
('don't we to go' XATO).

tasks.prompt: 12  This restaurant is ......... expensive   (birinchi bo'sh joy)
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'expensive' — UZUN sifat (3 bo'g'in)
→ 'MORE ... THAN'.

  'MORE expensive'  ✓
  'expensiveR'      ✗

1-band bilan solishtiring: 'fast' qisqa
→ 'faster'.
tasks.speak: 12  This restaurant is ......... expensive   (birinchi bo'sh joy)

tasks.prompt: 12  This restaurant is more expensive .......... that one.
tasks.whyUz:
QIYOSIY darajada DOIM 'THAN':
  'more expensive THAN'
  'faster THAN'
  'bigger THAN'

'more expensive AS' / 'FROM' — XATO.
tasks.speak: 12  This restaurant is more expensive .......... that one.

tasks.prompt: 13  My flat is big, but yours is much ......................... mine.
tasks.promptUz: Mening kvartiram katta, lekin siznikisi menikidan ancha kattaroq.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'big' — bitta undosh bilan tugagan qisqa
sifat → 'g' IKKILANADI: BIGGER.

Shunga o'xshash: hot → hotter, thin → thinner,
fat → fatter.

'MUCH bigger' — kuchaytirish (14-bandga
qarang).
tasks.speak: 13  My flat is big, but yours is much ......................... mine.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ QIYOSIY DARAJANI KUCHAYTIRISH:
  MUCH cheaper  ✓
  A LOT cheaper ✓
  FAR cheaper   ✓
  VERY cheaper  ✗ !!!

'very' faqat ODDIY sifat bilan: 'very cheap'.

(2-mashqning 6-bandi ham shu qoida.)

⚠ 'BE afraid' — 'HAVE afraid' XATO!

'SCARED' ham to'g'ri: 'Don't be scared.'

'Don't BE ...' — 'be' fe'lining inkor buyruq
shakli (2-nazorat testi, 3-mashq).

tasks.prompt: 16  There aren't any biscuits. John ............... them all.
tasks.promptUz: Pechenye qolmagan. Jon hammasini yeb qo'ydi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  B heavy
   2  B alive
   3  C than
   4  A start
   5  B in
   6  C much
   7  A desperately
   8  B too
   9  B with
  10  C better


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'There is HEAVY traffic in the streets
     today.'
    ⚠ 'HEAVY traffic' = qalin tirbandlik
    (turg'un birikma).
    'long traffic' / 'hot traffic' — mavjud
       emas.

    'heavy' ning boshqa birikmalari:
       heavy rain, heavy snow, heavy smoker

 2  'He was very lucky to be ALIVE.'
    ⚠ 'ALIVE' = tirik (SIFAT, otdan KEYIN).
    'live' /lɪv/ = yashamoq (FE'L).
    'living' = tirik (otdan OLDIN:
       'a living thing').

    ⚠ 'alive' otdan OLDIN kelmaydi:
       'He is ALIVE.'      ✓
       'an alive man'      ✗
       'a LIVING man'      ✓

 3  'Bob is older THAN Mary.'
    QIYOSIY darajada DOIM 'THAN'.

 4  'He tried to START the car but he
     couldn't.'
    ⚠ 'START a car' = mashinani yurgizmoq.
    'begin' — 'boshlamoq', lekin mashina
       uchun ishlatilmaydi.
    'turn on' — chiroq, televizor uchun.

    (Coursebook 112-bet: 'It's STARTED now!')

 5  'He is the cleverest boy IN the class.'
    ⚠ USTUN daraja + GURUH → 'IN'.
       'the best IN the class/world/team'
       'the tallest IN your city'

 6  'He is MUCH younger than his brother.'
    ⚠ QIYOSIY darajani kuchaytirish → MUCH.
       'MUCH younger'  ✓
       'VERY younger'  ✗
       'QUITE younger' ✗

    (1-mashqning 14-bandi ham shu qoida.)

 7  'Help! she screamed DESPERATELY.'
    ⚠ 'desperately' = umidsizlik bilan,
    jon-jahdi bilan — qichqiriqqa mos.
    'tightly' = mahkam (ushlash haqida).
    'scarily' = qo'rqinchli tarzda
       (boshqalarni qo'rqitish).

 8  'I can't afford it. It's TOO expensive.'
    ⚠ 'TOO + sifat' = HADDAN TAShQARI
    (salbiy).
    KALIT: 'I CAN'T AFFORD it' — narx
       MUAMMO.
    'much expensive' — XATO ('much' faqat
       qiyosiy daraja bilan).
    'quite expensive' — 'ancha qimmat',
       lekin 'can't afford' bilan zaifroq.

 9  'This restaurant is popular WITH
     visitors.'
    ⚠ 'popular WITH somebody' — predlog
    'with'.

10  'Your picture is BETTER than Tony's.'
    ⚠ 'than' bor → QIYOSIY daraja.
    good → BETTER → the best

    'well' — ravish ('He sings well').
    'best' — USTUN daraja ('the best'),
       'than' bilan kelmaydi.


⚠ 8-BAND — 'TOO' va 'MUCH' FARQI:

  TOO + oddiy sifat:
     'TOO expensive' = juda qimmat

  MUCH + qiyosiy daraja:
     'MUCH more expensive' = ancha qimmatroq

  'much expensive' — XATO!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  heavy traffic = qalin tirbandlik
  lucky      = omadli
  alive      = tirik
  to start a car = mashinani yurgizmoq
  clever     = aqlli
  to scream  = qichqirmoq
  desperately = jon-jahdi bilan
  tightly    = mahkam
  to afford  = sotib olishga qurbi yetmoq
  popular with = ... orasida mashhur
  a visitor  = tashrifchi

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ 1, 2, 3, 5-bandlarda savolning OXIRI
allaqachon bosilgan — faqat BOShINI
to'ldirish kerak.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'DID YOU HAVE a nice time?'
    B: 'Yes, I did, thanks.'

 2  A: 'WAS HE AT home last night?'
    B: 'No, he wasn't. He was at work.'

 3  A: 'SHALL WE go out tonight?'
    B: 'No, I'm tired.'

 4  A: 'WHAT ARE YOU DOING?'
    B: 'I'm cooking dinner.'

 5  A: 'HOW WAS YOUR HOLIDAY IN Jamaica?'
    B: 'It was fantastic!'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... a nice time?'
    Javob: 'Yes, I DID, thanks.'
    ⚠ 'I did' — demak savol 'DID YOU ...?'
    → 'Did you have a nice time?'

 2  Bosilgan: '... home last night?'
    Javob: 'No, he WASN'T. He was AT work.'
    ⚠ 'he wasn't' — demak savol 'WAS HE
    ...?'
    'at work' ga zid → 'at home'
    → 'Was he at home last night?'

 3  Bosilgan: '... go out tonight?'
    Javob: 'No, I'm tired.' — TAKLIFNI RAD
    etish.
    → 'Shall we go out tonight?'

    ⚠ 'Why don't we go out tonight?' ham
    to'g'ri (1-mashqning 7 va 11-bandlari).

 4  Javob: 'I'm COOKING dinner.' —
    PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
    → 'What are you doing?'

 5  Bosilgan: '... Jamaica?'
    Javob: 'It WAS fantastic!' — o'tmish,
    baho.
    → 'How was your holiday in Jamaica?'

    ⚠ 'What was Jamaica like?' ham to'g'ri.


⚠ 1 va 2-BANDLAR — QISQA JAVOBDAN
SAVOLNI TOPISh:

  Qisqa javobdagi YORDAMChI FE'L savolda
  ham bo'ladi:

     'Yes, I DID.'     → 'DID you ...?'
     'No, he WASN'T.'  → 'WAS he ...?'
     'Yes, I AM.'      → 'ARE you ...?'
     'No, I CAN'T.'    → 'CAN you ...?'

  Bu — testdagi eng foydali usul!


⚠ 2-BANDDA ZID SO'Z:

  Javobda 'He was AT WORK' deyilgan.
  Demak savolda BOShQA joy bo'lgan →
  'AT HOME'.

  (1-nazorat testining 3-mashqi, 4-bandi
   ham shunday edi: 'He's SHORT' → savolda
   'TALL'.)


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A NICE TIME':
  'to have a nice/good/wonderful time'
  = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq

  Coursebook 114-bet: 'We had A WONDERFUL
  TIME in Portugal.'


DIQQAT — 'GO OUT':
  'to go out' = sayr qilgani chiqmoq
  'to go out with somebody' = birov bilan
     uchrashmoq

  (5-nazorat testi, 12-band: 'Who did you
   GO OUT WITH?')


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to have a nice time = yaxshi vaqt
                 o'tkazmoq
  at work    = ishda
  to go out  = sayr qilgani chiqmoq
  tired      = charchagan
  Jamaica    = Yamayka
  fantastic  = ajoyib

sentencePatterns.formula: [A] is [sifat]ER THAN [B].   /   [A] is MORE [uzun sifat] THAN [B].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is heavier than me. Paris is more beautiful than Vienna.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mendan og'irroq. Parij Venadan chiroyliroq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She is much cleverer than her sister. The cheetah is much faster than the lion.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U singlisidan ancha aqlliroq. Gepard sherdan ancha tezroq.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'MUCH / A LOT / FAR' + qiyosiy daraja.
'VERY cleverer' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: [A] is THE [ustun daraja] IN [guruh].   /   ... OF ALL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: John is the shortest student in his class. Tennis is the best sport of all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon sinfidagi eng past bo'yli o'quvchi. Tennis hammasidan yaxshi sport.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Villages are not as dirty as large cities.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'as ... as' orasida ODDIY sifat
('as dirtier as' XATO).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is proud. She plays well. She heard a loud noise.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U faxrlanadi. U yaxshi o'ynaydi. U baland shovqin eshitdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [A] is + [sifat]ER + THAN + [B].   /   [A] is MORE + [uzun sifat] + THAN + [B].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: A plane travels faster than a train. This restaurant is more expensive than that one.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Samolyot poyezddan tezroq. Bu restoran anavisidan qimmatroq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: His car is much cheaper than yours. He is much younger than his brother.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uning mashinasi siznikidan ancha arzon. U akasidan ancha yosh.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'MUCH / A LOT / FAR' + qiyosiy daraja.
'VERY cheaper' — XATO!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He is the cleverest boy in the class. What's the tallest building in your city?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U sinfdagi eng aqlli bola. Shahringizdagi eng baland bino qaysi?

sentencePatterns.formula: WHY DON'T WE / SHALL WE + [ASOSIY fe'l] ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why don't we go to Paris? Shall we go out tonight?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega Parijga bormaymiz? Bugun kechqurun sayrga chiqaylikmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
TAKLIF shakllari.
'How about GOING?' — bu yerda V-ing!

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was in the kitchen when the doorbell rang.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringlaganda u oshxonada edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Davom etayotgan HOLAT + to'satdan sodir
bo'lgan ish → 'WHEN'.

sentencePatterns.formula: It's TOO + [sifat].   ↔   It's MUCH MORE + [sifat] THAN ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It's too expensive. It's much more expensive than that one.
